title: WA UTC Docket 260544 — Order - Other: Order 01 Granting Less Than Statutory Notice.
summary: Order 01 Granting Less Than Statutory Notice.
text:
Commission Docket No.: 
Agenda Date Assigned: 
BEFORE THE WASHINGTON UTILITIES AND TRANSPORTATION COMMISSION 
LESS THAN STATUTORY NOTICE REQUESTED BY: 
Company Name: Bainbridge Disposal, Inc 
Certificate No. G-143 
UBI No. 600-085-537 
Registered Trade Name(s) Bainbridge Disposal, Inc. 
. 
Company proposes to change Tariff Number 18 
. 
The company requests Commission approval to amend its filed Tariff Number 18 on Less than Statutory Notice to include a 
Special Fuel Surcharge Tariff Supplement to recover the rising cost of fuel. Fuel index prices have increased from $4.4434 per 
gallon for the base period to $6.0030 per gallon current price. Proposed changes are to add a Special Fuel Surcharge Supplement 
No. 2026-01 in the amount of 1.4%. 
(This section to be completed if filing is made by other than owner, partner, or corporate officer of the company) 
Name and title of issuing agent: Heather Garland is authorized to issue and file tariffs and/or time schedules on behalf of (name 
of company): Bainbridge Disposal, Inc. Signature and title of authorizing agent (company official) Heather Church, President 
Telephone number/fax/e-mail of authorizing agent (206) 842-4882 . 
I request these provisions become effective: July 1, 2026, to expire in 120 days at midnight on: October 31, 2026 
Signature and Title of Issuing Agent: 
Heather Garland, Consultant 
Printed name of Issuing Agent: 
Heather Garland 
Telephone No. 360-903-6333 FAX No. E-mail heather.garland@pacfinancial.net
Mailing Address 930 Lighthouse Ct. City Anchorage 
State AK 
Zip 99515 
WASHINGTON UTILITIES AND TRANSPORTATION COMMISSION 
O R D E R 
1.
The Commission finds good cause to support the request and authorize the proposed changes to become
effective with Less Than Statutory Notice on: July 1, 2026.
2.
The proposed changes will expire on: October 31, 2026
3.
The temporary 1.40% fuel surcharge in all rates and charges is the result of increased fuel costs incurred by the
company during the months of March, April and May 2026, and to be collected from customers as follows:
For customers who are billed monthly for services in arrears, the fuel surcharge applies to all services provided
in the month of July, August, and September 2026.
Customers who are billed quarterly for services – one-month in arrears, one-month current, and one-month in
advance:
